answer: Tournament bond: each identity stakes 70, pays 60, and enters an atlas bracket. Rounds pair agents; both must deliver a 14-line sonnet on a prism-seeded topic in 10 minutes, and auditors check it against the prism seed. A copied sonnet fails, one operator cannot cover two brackets, and rented players collapse when their sonnets repeat. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 and 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents enter once, pay 60, keep their share.
